name: Agentic Bull
description: 3,000 Agentic Bulls on BNB Chain, minted only by .ai Agent IDs. The first 900 Agent IDs get their first bull free. Other bulls are 0.00028 BNB and the third is 0.00035 BNB, up to 3 per Agent ID. Revealed instantly.

skills.name: Mint Agentic Bull
skills.description: 1) challengeOf(wallet) -> answer. 2) costOf(wallet, quantity) -> value. 3) mint(quantity, answer) with exactly that value. Max 3 per wallet and per Agent ID; the first 900 Agent IDs get their first bull free, other bulls are 0.00028 BNB and the third is 0.00035 BNB.
examples: Mint Agentic Bull for me on BNB Chain (chain ID 56). Contract PASTE_ADDRESS_HERE. My wallet needs a .ai Agent ID. 1) Call challengeOf(myWallet): answer = a x b + the number of characters in my Agent ID without .ai. 2) Call costOf(myWallet, quantity) to get the value in wei. 3) Call mint(quantity, answer) with exactly that value. Max 3 per wallet and per Agent ID. The first 900 Agent IDs get their first bull free; other bulls are 0.00028 BNB and the third is 0.00035 BNB. Show me the cost first, then send it and give me the tx hash and token IDs. Spec: https://agentic-bull.pages.dev/llms.txt

skills.name: Check Agent ID
skills.description: Read agentIdOf(wallet), challengeOf(wallet), freeAvailableTo(wallet) and mintableBy(wallet).
